senses.gloss:
लीला लीला (akin to लस्), f.
 1. Play, sport, pastime, Pañc. 161, 15; लीलया (instr.), Sportively, Pañc. 229, 10; easily, without any effort, Pañc. 211, 12; Hit. 81, 18.
 2. Amorous or wanton sport, Pañc. iii. d. 237.
 --Comp.
लीलावती लीलावती, i. e. लीला + वन्त् + ई, f. A wanton woman, Hit. i. d. 193, M.M.
